RoyalTitleDef.label: Squire
RoyalTitleDef.description: A sworn attendant learning the duties of arms and service. The first honor earned in service to Valyria. These titles confer standing, not psychic powers, and never forbid honest work.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Knight
RoyalTitleDef.description: A sworn knight recognized for courage, honorable conduct, and faithful service to the houses of Valyria.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Landed Knight
RoyalTitleDef.description: A knight recognized as worthy of a landed household and its duties. This honor grants standing, not a new settlement.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Lord
RoyalTitleDef.description: A recognized head of a Valyrian house, bound to protect its people and honor sworn obligations.

RoyalTitleDef.label: High Lord
RoyalTitleDef.description: A High Lord, also called a Great Lord, commands the respect of lesser houses and carries greater responsibility for Valyria.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Lord Paramount
RoyalTitleDef.description: Valyria's highest honor, recognizing exceptional leadership and service to its great families. It grants your House standing without replacing Valyria's ruler or transferring its lands.
